notes.title: 📢 Welcome to Trimeria - Thief Smile! 🎭
notes.content:
Adventurers! We are thrilled to share this with you. Trimeria - Thief Smile is now available on platforms, and we couldn’t be more excited for you to embark on this magical adventure. 🎭

From the very beginning, we dreamed of bringing this story to more players and platforms, and now, at last, you can immerse yourself in the world of Eva, a young jester apprentice, on her mission to restore joy to her village. A mysterious demon has stolen everyone’s smiles, and only you can help her face this threat with creativity and artistic skills.

🎮 Explore a world full of secrets.
🧩 Solve puzzles and challenge your wit.
🎶 A journey where art comes to life.

[previewyoutube=0gTNlbHLkpo;full][/previewyoutube]

Follow us on social media to stay updated on news, exclusive content, and surprises we have in store. See you on this adventure!
